name: keelgrc-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Keel GRC API: drive your compliance program from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client.
author: Keel GRC LLC

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run smoke

//overrides: fast-uri <3.1.6 carries four HIGH advisories (SSRF and host confusion, GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8 and three siblings). It reaches this tree only through @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> ajv, whose range is ^3.0.1, so the floor is set here. Bounded to the current major deliberately: an unbounded ">=" range resolves to the newest release on any major, which turns a security patch into a breaking upgrade. Drop this once ajv ships a range that starts at or above the floor.
